title: Employment Protection Reforms: From Firm-Level Effects to Aggregate Outcomes
title_primary: Employment Protection Reforms: From Firm-Level Effects to Aggregate Outcomes
authors: Pierre Cahuc, Pauline Carry, Franck Malherbet, Pedro Silva Martins
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Employment protection legislation often varies with firm or establishment size and age, and many evaluations of EPL reforms exploit these thresholds. This paper develops a search-and-matching model with multi-establishment firms to disentangle direct effects from general-equilibrium spillovers. We combine the model with quasi-experimental evidence from a 2009 Portuguese reform that restricted fixed-term contracts in young establishments of large firms. Spillovers barely distort the reduced-form estimate, yet they overturn the aggregate conclusion: extrapolating the reduced-form estimate implies a 1.51% employment decline, compared with a 0.11% increase in general equilibrium. Counterfactuals show that conditioning EPL on size versus age can yield opposite welfare effects, even when employment effects are similar, and that fixed-term contract and firing restrictions must be evaluated jointly.

title: Joint production, externalities, and terrace conservation strategies
title_zh: 联合生产、外部性与梯田保护策略
title_primary: 联合生产、外部性与梯田保护策略
title_secondary: Joint production, externalities, and terrace conservation strategies
authors: Yingqian Huang, Hualou Long
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Multifunctional agriculture jointly produces commodity and non-commodity outputs, yet many non-commodity benefits are underprovided due to insufficient economic incentives. This challenge is amplified in the agriculture-tourism nexus, where tourism depends on agricultural landscapes while potentially contributing to their degradation, creating interconnected externalities that distort benefit distribution and undermine joint production efficiency. This study extends joint production theory to the agriculture-tourism nexus by developing a framework for integrated terraced agriculture-ecotourism production, in which tourism generates conservation incentives by capturing economic value from landscape and environmental services. We identify the socially optimal provision of agricultural non-commodity benefits under different landscape loss scenarios and examine how externality internalization and multi-stakeholder collaboration affect joint production efficiency. The results show that achieving optimal multifunctionality requires balancing the benefits and costs of externality internalization across agricultural and tourism activities. Failure to do so may reduce joint production efficiency by distorting factor income distribution. Multi-stakeholder collaboration improves benefit allocation and lowers internalization costs, enabling the socially optimal provision of agricultural non-commodity benefits. These findings underscore the need for integrated governance mechanisms that align economic incentives with ecological conservation in mountainous regions.

title: Urban form under China’s politico-economic transition: The role of decentralization, marketization, globalization, and regionalization in the Greater Bay Area
title_zh: 中国政治经济转型下的城市形态：粤港澳大湾区中分权、市场化、全球化与区域化的作用
title_primary: 中国政治经济转型下的城市形态：粤港澳大湾区中分权、市场化、全球化与区域化的作用
title_secondary: Urban form under China’s politico-economic transition: The role of decentralization, marketization, globalization, and regionalization in the Greater Bay Area
authors: Shiyi Wang, Yangyi Wu, Xianchun Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Urban form is undergoing rapid transformation amid global politico-economic transitions, yet the mechanisms shaping these changes in non-Western contexts remain under-theorized. Taking China’s transition as an example, we reconceptualize the transition by adding regionalization into the traditional framework of decentralization, marketization, and globalization, highlighting the role of regional cooperation. We delineate the evolution of urban form through morphological analysis in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area (GBA) from 2010 to 2019, and employ regression methods to validate the pathways through which this extended transitional framework influences form outcomes. Empirical results demonstrate that urban form is co-shaped by local governments’ fiscal expenditure, land market prices, foreign direct investment, and the intensity of inter-city cooperation. A compound growth model integrating industrial land, transport networks, and real estate is emerging as a significant mechanism forging urban spatial structure. Overall, our study reaffirms the pivotal impact of local government play among the various actors shaping urban development and spatial configuration in China. While regionalization has shown tangible effects in enhancing inter-city collaboration and reducing regional disparities, it has yet to fundamentally transform the entrenched governance logic through which local governments leverage land markets to drive urban growth.
abstract_zh: 在全球政治经济转型的背景下，城市形态正经历快速变革，然而在非西方情境下塑造这些变化的机制仍未得到充分理论化。以中国的转型为例，我们通过将区域化纳入传统的分权化、市场化与全球化分析框架中，重新概念化这一转型过程，并强调区域合作的作用。我们运用形态分析方法，描绘了2010年至2019年间粤港澳大湾区城市形态的演变，并采用回归方法验证了这一扩展转型框架影响形态结果的路径。实证结果表明，城市形态受到地方政府财政支出、土地市场价格、外商直接投资及城际合作强度的共同塑造。一个整合工业用地、交通网络与房地产的复合增长模式，正成为塑造城市空间结构的重要机制。总体而言，本研究重申了地方政府在中国城市发展与空间格局塑造的多元主体中所发挥的关键作用。尽管区域化在增强城际协作与缩小区域差距方面已显现出切实成效，但其尚未从根本上改变地方政府借助土地市场驱动城市增长的固有治理逻辑。

title: Employee Advocacy, Personal Branding, and Employer Attractiveness in the Digital Era: An integrative conceptual framework
title_zh: 数字时代的员工倡导、个人品牌与雇主吸引力：一个整合性概念框架
title_primary: 数字时代的员工倡导、个人品牌与雇主吸引力：一个整合性概念框架
title_secondary: Employee Advocacy, Personal Branding, and Employer Attractiveness in the Digital Era: An integrative conceptual framework
authors: Fatima Ezzahra Khouiammi (UCA - Université Cadi Ayyad = Cadi Ayyad University [Marrakech]), Zayer Chaimaa (UIC - Université Internationale de Casablanca)
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In the digital era, organizations are increasingly relying on employee-generated communication to shape their employer brand image. This study proposes an integrative conceptual framework that examines the relationships between personal branding, employee advocacy, and employer brand attractiveness, while accounting for the moderating role of social media use. Drawing on Social Identity Theory, identity expressiveness theory and Social Exchange Theory, it argues that employees who actively develop their personal brand enhance their visibility, credibility, and professional image, which motivates them to engage in promotional behaviors that benefit their organization. These promotional behaviors, in turn, influence the organization's external image and strengthen the appeal of the employer brand, defined as the perceived benefits of working for a given organization. Furthermore, this theoretical framework suggests that the use of social media strengthens these ties by providing a platform through which employees can express both their personal identity and organizational identity, and reach a wider audience. Methodologically, this study adopts a theory-based integrative literature review relying on a structured analysis of prior research in the fields of organizational behavior, communication, and employer branding. By integrating previously fragmented lines of research, this study contributes to the literature by highlighting the role of employee advocacy as a key mediating mechanism and the use of social media as a contextual moderator in the relationship between personal branding and employer brand attractiveness. The study concludes that personal branding positively influences employee advocacy, which in turn strengthens employer brand attractiveness, while social media use amplifies these relationships in digital environments.From a managerial perspective, it emphasizes the importance of empowering employees to act as agents of strategic communication in order to enhance the organization's appeal in competitive labor markets. Keywords : Personal branding, Employee advocacy, Employer brand attractiveness, Social media use.
abstract_zh: 在数字化时代，组织日益依赖员工生成的沟通来塑造其雇主品牌形象。本研究提出了一个综合性的概念框架，探讨个人品牌、员工倡导与雇主品牌吸引力之间的关系，并考虑社交媒体使用的调节作用。基于社会认同理论、身份表达理论和社会交换理论，本研究认为，积极发展个人品牌的员工能够提升其可见度、可信度和专业形象，从而激励他们参与有利于组织的推广行为。这些推广行为反过来影响组织的外部形象，并增强雇主品牌的吸引力，即感知到的在特定组织工作的益处。此外，该理论框架表明，社交媒体的使用通过提供一个平台，使员工能够同时表达个人身份和组织身份，并触达更广泛的受众，从而强化这些联系。在方法论上，本研究采用基于理论的结构化综合文献综述方法，系统分析组织行为学、传播学和雇主品牌领域的先前研究。通过整合以往分散的研究线索，本研究为文献贡献在于强调员工倡导作为关键中介机制，以及社交媒体使用作为个人品牌与雇主品牌吸引力之间关系的情境调节因素。研究得出结论：个人品牌正向影响员工倡导，进而增强雇主品牌吸引力，而社交媒体使用在数字环境中放大了这些关系。从管理视角来看，本研究强调赋权员工作为战略沟通代理人的重要性，以增强组织在竞争激烈的劳动力市场中的吸引力。关键词：个人品牌、员工倡导、雇主品牌吸引力、社交媒体使用。

title: Can structural reforms unleash private investment?
title_zh: 结构性改革能否释放私人投资？
title_primary: 结构性改革能否释放私人投资？
title_secondary: Can structural reforms unleash private investment?
authors: Mavrogiannis, Christos & Zorell, Nico & Zwick, Christoph
official: 官方在线 2026-01-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the impact of labour and product market reforms on private investment across 26 advanced economies from 1975 to 2020. To this end, we combine a narrative database on major structural reforms with local projections and augmented inverse probability weighting. We find that a major labour market reform typically increases the level of real private investment by 5% cumulatively within six years, while a major product market reform yields an impact of 3%. Structural reforms are particularly effective in stimulating private investment when the private sector has access to ample external finance and the rule of law is strong. Overall, our findings point to an important role for structural reforms in boosting private investment and thus long-term growth prospects in advanced economies. JEL Classification: E22, O43, L51
abstract_zh: 本文考察了1975年至2020年间26个发达经济体中劳动力市场与产品市场改革对私人投资的影响。为此，我们结合了关于重大结构性改革的叙事数据库，并运用局部投影法及增强逆概率加权法进行分析。研究发现，一项重大的劳动力市场改革通常在六年内使实际私人投资水平累计增加5%，而一项重大的产品市场改革则带来3%的影响。当私营部门能够获得充足的外部融资且法治环境健全时，结构性改革在刺激私人投资方面尤为有效。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，结构性改革在促进私人投资及进而推动发达经济体长期增长前景方面发挥着重要作用。JEL分类号：E22, O43, L51

title: Beefing Up the Service Sector: Commodity Export Booms and Production Network Spillovers
title_zh: 壮大服务业：大宗商品出口繁荣与生产网络溢出效应
title_primary: 壮大服务业：大宗商品出口繁荣与生产网络溢出效应
title_secondary: Beefing Up the Service Sector: Commodity Export Booms and Production Network Spillovers
authors: Francesco Amodio, Giorgio Chiovelli, Serafin Frache
official: 官方在线 2025-03-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We show that commodity export booms can propagate up the value chain, reshape production networks, and drive growth and transformation in the service sector. We study Uruguay’s beef export boom to China in the 2010s, combining customs, firm-to-firm transactions, employer-employee, and balance sheet data. Domestic suppliers to beef exporters that expanded trade with China recorded higher sales, especially in services, with associated gains in employment, wages, and sales per worker, along with increased imports of high-quality products. Aggregate sales in the economy rose by 1.79%, with each export dollar generating 46 more cents in domestic sales, including 10 cents in services. Over time, service firms reoriented their connections toward beef exporters, amplifying their gains from trade.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，大宗商品出口繁荣能够沿价值链向上传导，重塑生产网络，并推动服务业的增长与转型。我们以2010年代乌拉圭对华牛肉出口繁荣为研究对象，结合海关数据、企业间交易记录、雇主-雇员匹配数据及资产负债表数据进行分析。与扩大对华贸易的牛肉出口商有国内供应关系的企业，其销售额有所增长，尤其在服务业领域表现突出，同时伴随就业、工资及人均销售额的提升，以及高质量产品进口的增加。整体经济总销售额增长了1.79%，每1美元出口额额外带动46美分的国内销售，其中服务业贡献10美分。随着时间推移，服务企业将其业务联系重新导向牛肉出口商，从而放大了其从贸易中获得的收益。

title: Contingent capital with contingent share repurchase clause
title_zh: 附条件股份回购条款的应急资本
title_primary: 附条件股份回购条款的应急资本
title_secondary: Contingent capital with contingent share repurchase clause
authors: Xianwei Lin, Franck Moraux, Xuezhi Qin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Existing contingent convertible bonds (CoCos) have several drawbacks for investors and issuers. This paper introduces the CCCR, a hybrid security that improves upon CoCos by adding an automatic share repurchase mechanism, requiring the company to repurchase shares if its financial condition worsens after the conversion of contingent debt securities into equity. We develop a structural model based on Leland’s framework to analyze a firm’s optimal capital structure, which includes equity, CCCR, and a straight debt. The model endogenously determines the CCCR’s features, and we derive pricing formulas for the firm’s liabilities. To ensure applicability, we derive a condition and corresponding minimum conversion ratio ensuring a one-to-one mapping between equity value and firm asset value. Our analysis of credit spreads, asset substitution, and other key financial metrics shows that, compared to alternative financing options, capital structures incorporating CCCR offer significant advantages for investors while imposing minimal additional costs on issuing firms, establishing this new security as a rational and viable form of contingent capital.
abstract_zh: 现有的或有可转换债券（CoCos）对投资者和发行方存在若干缺陷。本文介绍了一种混合证券——CCCR，它通过增加自动股份回购机制改进了CoCos，要求公司在或有债务证券转换为股权后，若财务状况恶化，则需回购股份。我们基于Leland框架构建了一个结构化模型，以分析企业的最优资本结构，该结构包括股权、CCCR和普通债务。模型内生地确定了CCCR的特征，并推导出企业负债的定价公式。为确保适用性，我们推导出一个条件及相应的最低转换比率，以保证股权价值与企业资产价值之间的一一对应关系。我们对信用利差、资产替代及其他关键财务指标的分析表明，与替代融资方案相比，包含CCCR的资本结构为投资者提供了显著优势，同时对发行企业施加的额外成本极小，从而确立了这一新证券作为合理且可行的或有资本形式。

title: How policy addressees intend to respond to EU policy change? A cross-country survey analysis of forest owner behavioral types and responses to EU biodiversity and climate objectives
title_zh: 政策对象如何应对欧盟政策变化？森林所有者行为类型及其对欧盟生物多样性与气候目标响应的跨国调查分析
title_primary: 政策对象如何应对欧盟政策变化？森林所有者行为类型及其对欧盟生物多样性与气候目标响应的跨国调查分析
title_secondary: How policy addressees intend to respond to EU policy change? A cross-country survey analysis of forest owner behavioral types and responses to EU biodiversity and climate objectives
authors: Metodi Sotirov, Jens Nilsson, Karin Beland-Lindahl, Mireia Pecurul-Botines, Krzysztof Niedzialkowski 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How do forest owners and managers – as policy addressees - intend to respond to EU policy – such as biodiversity and climate policy objectives - across different national contexts? Addressing this question, the study builds on social science behavioral theories to derive forest owner and manager types (FOTs) based on distinct decision-making logics. Using survey data from 1573 respondents in five European countries (Germany, Poland, Slovenia, Spain, and Sweden) and applying hierarchical cluster analysis, the study quantitatively identifies and validates these behavioral types across diverse institutional and ecological settings. The results show that multifunctionalists consistently support EU biodiversity and climate objectives, while optimizers tend to prioritize economic outcomes and often oppose regulatory interventions. Environmentalists display generally positive but context-dependent responses, whereas traditionalists show more limited support, particularly for stricter conservation measures. Across countries, the presence of similar behavioral types but varying response patterns highlights the importance of national context in shaping policy support and resistance. By linking behavioral typologies to EU policy objectives, the study advances forest policy and Europeanization research by introducing an actor-centered explanation of differentiated policy implementation outcomes. The findings provide insights for more targeted and context-sensitive policy design, while acknowledging the limits of survey-based measures of behavioral responses.
abstract_zh: 森林所有者和管理者作为政策对象，在不同国家背景下如何回应欧盟政策——例如生物多样性和气候政策目标？针对这一问题，本研究基于社会科学行为理论，依据不同的决策逻辑推导出森林所有者和管理者类型（FOTs）。利用来自五个欧洲国家（德国、波兰、斯洛文尼亚、西班牙和瑞典）1573名受访者的调查数据，并应用层次聚类分析，研究在多样化的制度和生态情境中定量识别并验证了这些行为类型。结果表明，多功能主义者始终支持欧盟的生物多样性和气候目标，而优化者倾向于优先考虑经济结果，并常常反对监管干预。环保主义者表现出总体积极但依情境而异的回应，而传统主义者则显示出较为有限的支持，尤其是在更严格的保护措施方面。跨国比较显示，相似行为类型的存在但回应模式各异，凸显了国家背景在塑造政策支持与抵制中的重要性。通过将行为类型学与欧盟政策目标相联系，本研究引入了一种以行动者为中心的解释，推进了森林政策和欧洲化研究，阐明了政策实施结果的差异性。研究结果为更具针对性和情境敏感性的政策设计提供了见解，同时也承认基于调查的行为回应测量存在局限性。

title: How Public Financial Management Shapes Education and Health Outcomes: A Configurational Perspective
title_zh: 公共财政管理如何塑造教育与健康结果：一种组态视角
title_primary: 公共财政管理如何塑造教育与健康结果：一种组态视角
title_secondary: How Public Financial Management Shapes Education and Health Outcomes: A Configurational Perspective
authors: Singh, Kaushiki, Sutherland, Richard Anthony
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-08-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This study examines how configurations of public financial management performance, sectoral spending, and governance context shape education and health outcomes across developing and middle-income economies. Using fuzzy set qualitative comparative analysis and Bayesian robustness checks, the analysis identifies multiple sufficient pathways linking budget execution credibility to primary education, secondary education, universal health coverage, and under five mortality outcomes. The findings confirm that public financial management conditions operate through conjunctural combinations rather than linear channels, their explanatory reach is stronger for intermediate than longer term outcomes, and strong aggregate and revenue execution can compensate for low sectoral spending. Budget credibility at the execution stage emerges as the central operative mechanism.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了公共财政管理绩效、部门支出与治理环境的不同组合如何影响发展中及中等收入经济体的教育与健康成果。运用模糊集定性比较分析与贝叶斯稳健性检验，分析识别出多条充分路径，将预算执行可信度与初等教育、中等教育、全民健康覆盖及五岁以下儿童死亡率等结果联系起来。研究发现证实，公共财政管理条件通过组合性联动而非线性渠道发挥作用，其解释力对中期成果强于长期成果，且强劲的总量与收入执行可弥补部门支出的不足。执行阶段的预算可信度成为核心运作机制。

title: Grabbing the forbidden fruit: Restriction-sensitive choice
title_zh: 摘取禁果：限制敏感型选择
title_primary: 摘取禁果：限制敏感型选择
title_secondary: Grabbing the forbidden fruit: Restriction-sensitive choice
authors: Niels Boissonnet, Alexis Ghersengorin
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Restricting individuals’ access to some opportunities may steer their desire toward their substitutes, a phenomenon known as the forbidden fruit effect. We axiomatize a choice model named restriction-sensitive choice (RSC), which rationalizes the forbidden fruit effect and is compatible with the prominent psychological explanations: reactance theory and commodity theory. The model is identifiable from choice data, specifically from the observation of choice reversals caused by the removal of options. We conduct a normative analysis both in terms of the agent’s freedom and welfare. We apply our model to shed light on two phenomena: the backfire effect of beliefs and the backlash of integration policies targeted toward minorities.
abstract_zh: 限制个体获取某些机会可能会将其欲望引向替代品，这一现象被称为“禁果效应”。我们构建了一个名为“限制敏感选择”（RSC）的选择模型，该模型能够合理化禁果效应，并与主要的心理学解释——抗拒理论与商品理论——相兼容。该模型可从选择数据中识别，特别是通过观察因选项移除而导致的选择反转。我们从个体自由与福利两方面进行了规范性分析。我们将该模型应用于阐明两种现象：信念的反作用效应及针对少数群体的融合政策所引发的反弹效应。

abstract: Using panel data on a 20% random sample of Canadian taxpayers, we study behavioral responses to the cancellation of a lifetime capital gains exemption that resulted in increased capital gains taxation for some individuals. We show that the exemption did not change the number of taxpayers reporting positive capital gains, and thus unlikely resulted in increased participation in capital markets. Furthermore, our results suggest that the cancellation increased the long-run capital gains realizations of tax filers with more unused exemption room but had a small, statistically insignificant impact on the capital gains realizations of those with little unused exemption room.
abstract_zh: 利用加拿大纳税人20%随机样本的面板数据，我们研究了终身资本利得豁免取消对行为的影响，该取消导致部分个人的资本利得税负增加。研究表明，豁免并未改变申报正资本利得的纳税人数量，因此不太可能促进资本市场参与度的提升。此外，我们的结果表明，豁免取消增加了未使用豁免额度较多的纳税人的长期资本利得实现，但对未使用豁免额度较少的纳税人的资本利得实现影响较小且统计上不显著。

abstract: Imperfect competition within the pollution abatement equipment sector may hinder the Paris Agreement’s goals. We show that carbon tax–funded environmental subsidies can stimulate firm entry, enhance competition, and lower abatement costs for businesses. Using a quantitative macro-climate model with an endogenous market structure for abatement equipment, we estimate that optimally allocating subsidies (60% to startups and 40% to existing companies) could enhance efficiency, generating annual global GDP savings of $2.5 to $3.1 trillion by 2060.
abstract_zh: 污染减排设备行业的不完全竞争可能阻碍《巴黎协定》目标的实现。我们证明，由碳税资助的环境补贴能够刺激企业进入、增强竞争并降低企业的减排成本。通过构建一个包含减排设备内生市场结构的定量宏观气候模型，我们估算出最优补贴分配（60%给予初创企业，40%给予现有企业）能够提升效率，到2060年每年可为全球GDP节省2.5至3.1万亿美元。

title: Managing Persuasion Robustly: The Optimality of Quota Rules
title_zh: 稳健地管理说服：配额规则的最优性
title_primary: 稳健地管理说服：配额规则的最优性
title_secondary: Managing Persuasion Robustly: The Optimality of Quota Rules
authors: Dirk Bergemann, Tan Gan, Yingkai Li
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study a sender-receiver game in which the receiver can commit to a decision rule before the sender determines the information policy. We ask how the receiver should commit, in advance, to a rule that maps the information of the sender into decisions-when the receiver knows neither the sender’s true preferences nor the full range of information the sender could supply. To handle this dual uncertainty, we adopt a unified robust framework that nests max-min utility, min-max regret, and min-max competitive ratio as special cases. Across all criteria, the same answer emerges: the optimal rule is always a quota rule.
abstract_zh: 我们研究一个发送者-接收者博弈，其中接收者在发送者确定信息政策之前可以承诺一个决策规则。我们探讨接收者应如何事先承诺一个将发送者信息映射为决策的规则——当接收者既不知道发送者的真实偏好，也不了解发送者可能提供的全部信息范围时。为应对这种双重不确定性，我们采用一个统一的稳健框架，该框架将最大最小效用、最小最大遗憾和最小最大竞争比作为特例包含在内。在所有准则下，得出的答案一致：最优规则始终是配额规则。

title: Simultaneous and Sequential Competition With Asymmetric Information and Externalities
title_zh: 不对称信息与外部性下的同时与序贯竞争
title_primary: 不对称信息与外部性下的同时与序贯竞争
title_secondary: Simultaneous and Sequential Competition With Asymmetric Information and Externalities
authors: Eray Cumbul
official: 官方在线 2026-07-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the joint role of strategic timing, asymmetric private demand and cost information, and common ownership in shaping equilibrium outcomes in oligopolistic markets. We develop a three‐firm model and study Cournot and Stackelberg competition. The main results are as follows. (1) Mover advantages are determined by relative signal precision: the leader benefits most when the second mover has a more precise signal, the second mover benefits most when the last mover has high signal precision, and the last mover benefits when both followers have sufficiently noisy signals. (2) Cournot competition generates greater consumer and total surplus and lower total profits than Stackelberg competition if neither follower has significantly higher signal precision than the leader. (3) Common ownership increases consumer and total surplus but reduces total profits in Stackelberg competition if and only if the last mover is not substantially better informed than the leader. These findings have implications for contests, partnership, network, public good, common resource, and gas emission games with altruistic preferences. Since total profit in oligopoly models can be interpreted as aggregate welfare in these environments, the welfare rankings are reversed.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了战略时机、非对称私有需求与成本信息以及共同所有权在寡头垄断市场均衡结果中的联合作用。我们构建了一个三企业模型，并分析了古诺竞争与斯塔克伯格竞争。主要结论如下：（1）先动优势取决于相对信号精度：当后动者拥有更精确的信号时，先动者获益最大；当最后动者信号精度较高时，第二动者获益最大；当两个追随者的信号均足够模糊时，最后动者获益最大。（2）若任一追随者的信号精度未显著高于先动者，古诺竞争比斯塔克伯格竞争能带来更高的消费者剩余与总剩余，但总利润更低。（3）在斯塔克伯格竞争中，当且仅当最后动者的信息优势未显著超过先动者时，共同所有权会提升消费者剩余与总剩余，但降低总利润。这些发现对存在利他偏好的竞赛、合伙、网络、公共品、公共资源及气体排放博弈具有启示意义。由于寡头模型中的总利润可被解释为这些环境中的总福利，福利排序将发生逆转。

title: Teetering on the brink of debt and hunger: Empirical examination of the linkages between external debt and food security in Africa
title_zh: 摇摇欲坠于债务与饥饿边缘：非洲外债与粮食安全关联性的实证研究
title_primary: 摇摇欲坠于债务与饥饿边缘：非洲外债与粮食安全关联性的实证研究
title_secondary: Teetering on the brink of debt and hunger: Empirical examination of the linkages between external debt and food security in Africa
authors: Assem Abu Hatab, Emmanuel Orkoh
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-04-07 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Debt accumulation and food insecurity are two pressing challenges confronting developing countries, yet evidence on their link remains limited, particularly in Africa. This study uses balanced panel data from 32 African countries (2012–2022) to examine how external debt stock and servicing affect food security. Results support the notion that “the dose makes the poison”: higher debt stock undermines food security, with effects differing across its dimensions. Elevated debt stock is also associated with higher child stunting, reflecting long-term nutritional risks. Debt servicing has an even stronger negative effect, worsening availability, affordability, safety and quality of food, as well as child nutrition. Disaggregated analysis shows that debt sources matter: multilateral loans improve food security and reduce stunting, while bilateral and private loans have the opposite effect. These adverse effects persist across income levels, food-import dependency and infrastructural development, though with varying intensity. The findings highlight the need for African countries to balance external borrowing with effective debt management and channel borrowed funds into productive, sustainability-enhancing investments that strengthen food systems and protect vulnerable populations, particularly children.
abstract_zh: 债务积累与粮食不安全是发展中国家面临的两大紧迫挑战，然而关于二者之间联系的证据仍然有限，尤其是在非洲。本研究利用32个非洲国家（2012—2022年）的平衡面板数据，考察外债存量及其偿付如何影响粮食安全。结果支持“剂量决定毒性”的观点：较高的债务存量削弱粮食安全，且其影响在不同维度上存在差异。债务存量升高还与儿童发育迟缓率上升相关，反映出长期营养风险。债务偿付的负面效应更为显著，恶化粮食的可获得性、可负担性、安全性与质量，以及儿童营养状况。分解分析表明，债务来源具有重要影响：多边贷款改善粮食安全并降低发育迟缓率，而双边贷款和私人贷款则产生相反效果。这些不利影响在收入水平、粮食进口依赖度和基础设施发展程度不同的国家中均持续存在，尽管强度有所差异。研究结果强调，非洲国家需要在外部借款与有效债务管理之间取得平衡，并将借入资金引导至具有生产性和可持续性增强效应的投资中，以强化粮食体系并保护弱势群体，尤其是儿童。

title: The Great Reallocation Revisited: How Foreign Direct Investment Is (and Is Not) Shifting amid Heightened Geopolitical Tensions

authors: Avendano, Rolando, Blanchard, Emily, Olney, William, Santos Paulino, Amelia, Trentini, Claudia
official: 官方在线 2026-06-10 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines how global greenfield foreign direct investment (FDI) flows are evolving amid rising geoeconomic fragmentation. We use difference-in-differences and event study approaches to analyze changes in FDI around key bilateral inflection points. We find a decline in FDI from the US and broader Group of Seven Plus (G7+) into the PRC, concentrated in trade-exposed, efficiency-seeking sectors. Investment diversion—particularly from the PRC to Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) members and Latin America—is evident, but this growth was concentrated in less global value chain (GVC)-integrated activities, suggesting that GVC links may act as a constraint on investment relocation. These findings suggest that while tensions may be reshaping global investment, GVC dependencies are likely limiting firms’ ability to reallocate production at scale, making the “great reallocation” least evident where it was most expected.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在地缘经济碎片化加剧的背景下，全球绿地外商直接投资（FDI）流动的演变趋势。我们采用双重差分法和事件研究法，分析关键双边关系转折点前后FDI的变化。研究发现，来自美国及更广泛的七国集团+（G7+）经济体对中国的FDI有所下降，且主要集中在贸易敏感型、效率寻求型行业。投资转移现象明显——尤其是从中国流向东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）成员国和拉丁美洲——但这种增长集中于全球价值链（GVC）整合程度较低的活动，表明GVC联系可能对投资重新布局构成制约。这些发现表明，尽管地缘紧张局势可能正在重塑全球投资格局，但GVC依赖关系很可能限制了企业大规模重新配置生产能力，使得“大转移”在最被预期的领域反而最不明显。

title: Another way of teaching microeconomics: impact evaluation of the CORE project
title_zh: 微观经济学教学的另一种方式：CORE项目影响评估
title_primary: 微观经济学教学的另一种方式：CORE项目影响评估
title_secondary: Another way of teaching microeconomics: impact evaluation of the CORE project
authors: Federico Araya, Pablo Blanchard, Juan Camilo Cárdenas, Elisa Failache, Ivone Perazzo
official: 官方在线 2026-06-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Taking advantage of the random assignment of students in Uruguay to either a conventional introductory microeconomics course or one based on the Curriculum Open-access Resources in Economics (CORE) project, we provide causal evidence on the effects of CORE on students' academic performance, learning experience and study practices. We find no systematic differences in pass or dropout rates between the two courses. Similarly, we observe no significant differences in performance in the concurrent calculus course or in a subsequent advanced microeconomics course. Therefore we find no evidence of disadvantages in related subsequent courses resulting from the use of a CORE-based course. Consistent with the project's objectives, our results also show that students assigned to the non-conventional course are 18% more likely than those in the traditional course to believe that it contributed to their academic and professional development. Furthermore, assignment to CORE reduces the likelihood of students paying for private microeconomics tutoring outside school hours, and increases both class attendance and the likelihood of studying in groups.
abstract_zh: 利用乌拉圭学生被随机分配至传统微观经济学入门课程或基于经济学课程开放获取资源（CORE）项目的课程这一自然实验，我们提供了关于CORE对学生学业表现、学习体验及学习习惯影响的因果证据。我们发现，两种课程在通过率或辍学率上并无系统性差异。同样，在同步进行的微积分课程或后续高级微观经济学课程中，我们未观察到显著的表现差异。因此，我们没有发现使用基于CORE的课程对相关后续课程造成不利影响的证据。与项目目标一致，我们的结果还显示，被分配至非传统课程的学生比传统课程的学生更有可能认为该课程对其学术和职业发展有所贡献，这一可能性高出18%。此外，分配至CORE课程降低了学生课外付费接受私人微观经济学辅导的可能性，同时提高了课堂出勤率和小组学习的可能性。

title: Greener thy neighbor? On the welfare effects of protectionist climate policies
title_zh: 更绿色的邻居？论保护主义气候政策的福利效应
title_primary: 更绿色的邻居？论保护主义气候政策的福利效应
title_secondary: Greener thy neighbor? On the welfare effects of protectionist climate policies
authors: Saumya Deojain, David Lindequist
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The world is witnessing a surge in green industrial policies, with prominent examples such as the U.S. Inflation Reduction Act incorporating significant protectionist elements. We argue that such green protectionism can play a strategic role in fostering international coordination on climate action. In a simple model combining a standard abatement game with a beggar-thy-neighbor game, we show that protectionist policies improve welfare when expected distortions are low, as they facilitate coordination on climate mitigation at minimal costs. When expected distortions are high, protectionist measures are not adopted and are effectively welfare-neutral. However, when expected distortions are of intermediate size, unregulated protectionist climate policies lead countries to rely excessively on distortive instruments, reducing global welfare. Our findings suggest that regulators like the WTO can enhance welfare by restricting but not entirely banning green protectionist measures. When countries are asymmetric, the case for differentiated regulation depends on whether asymmetries primarily affect countries’ incentives to coordinate on abatement or the social cost of using protectionist instruments to sustain that coordination. We further find that efforts to reduce uncertainty about the size of distortions might backfire, inadvertently encouraging coordination on costly protectionist measures.
abstract_zh: 全球正经历绿色产业政策的激增，其中美国《通胀削减法案》等突出案例包含了显著的贸易保护主义元素。我们认为，此类绿色保护主义在促进国际气候行动协调方面可发挥战略性作用。在一个将标准减排博弈与以邻为壑博弈相结合的简单模型中，我们证明，当预期扭曲程度较低时，保护主义政策能够增进福利，因其以最小成本促进气候减缓方面的协调。当预期扭曲程度较高时，保护主义措施不会被采纳，且实际上对福利无影响。然而，当预期扭曲程度处于中间水平时，不受监管的保护主义气候政策会导致各国过度依赖扭曲性工具，从而降低全球福利。我们的研究结果表明，世界贸易组织等监管机构可通过限制而非完全禁止绿色保护主义措施来增进福利。当各国不对称时，差异化监管的合理性取决于不对称性主要影响各国协调减排的激励，还是影响用以维持该协调的保护主义工具的社会成本。我们进一步发现，减少扭曲规模不确定性的努力可能适得其反，无意中鼓励各国在代价高昂的保护主义措施上达成协调。

title: Targeting attitudes to combat sexual harassment: A randomized intervention in the Norwegian military
title_zh: 针对态度以打击性骚扰：挪威军队中的一项随机干预实验
title_primary: 针对态度以打击性骚扰：挪威军队中的一项随机干预实验
title_secondary: Targeting attitudes to combat sexual harassment: A randomized intervention in the Norwegian military
authors: Olle Folke, Torbjørn Hanson, Åshild A. Johnsen, Andreas Kotsadam, Johanna Rickne
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We develop an information-based intervention against sexual harassment and test it in a randomized control trial across small groups of military recruits in the boot camp of the Norwegian military. The intervention seeks to bridge two knowledge gaps with implications for sexual harassment prevalence. We tell some recruits about their peers’ beliefs that “telling sexualized jokes can be labeled sexual harassment” and about women soldiers’ equal performance on military skill tests. This treatment gives lasting improvements in knowledge about what sexual harassment is and about women’s job performance. The impact on sexual harassment prevalence is directionally negative but statistically insignificant. We discuss measurement error and use survey responses about a harassment scenario to argue that the intervention likely affected behavior. Our study provides the first field experiment to evaluate whether a prevention method against sexual harassment reduces prevalence in a work setting. We use insights from our research process to identify methodological pitfalls and provide guidance for future field experiments in this area.
abstract_zh: 我们设计了一项基于信息的性骚扰干预措施，并在挪威军队新兵训练营的小组随机对照试验中对其进行了测试。该干预旨在弥合两个与性骚扰发生率相关的知识缺口。我们告知部分新兵，其同伴认为“开性玩笑可被视为性骚扰”，以及女兵在军事技能测试中表现与男兵相当。这一干预持久地提升了关于性骚扰定义及女性工作表现的知识。对性骚扰发生率的影响方向为负，但统计上不显著。我们讨论了测量误差，并利用关于骚扰情境的问卷调查回应，论证该干预可能影响了行为。我们的研究提供了首个在职场环境中评估性骚扰预防方法能否降低其发生率的现场实验。我们利用研究过程中的洞察，识别方法论陷阱，并为该领域未来的现场实验提供指导。

title: Bitcoin growth amid climate change: Policy and investment implications
title_zh: 气候变化背景下的比特币增长：政策与投资启示
title_primary: 气候变化背景下的比特币增长：政策与投资启示
title_secondary: Bitcoin growth amid climate change: Policy and investment implications
authors: Mohammadhossein Lashkaripour, Seyedmehdi Hosseini, Rizwan Ahmed
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Bitcoin contributes to global carbon emissions on a scale comparable to entire countries in order to secure its decentralized network. This exposes Bitcoin to climate policies aimed at reducing emissions. This paper develops a general equilibrium framework to examine how the stringency of climate policy affects Bitcoin’s valuation and its relationship with the equity market. Our theoretical analysis delivers a key insight: a transition from a lenient to a stringent climate policy increases the conditional correlation between Bitcoin and equity returns, thereby compromising Bitcoin’s appeal as a hedge or diversifier against equity market volatility. Empirical evidence supports this theoretical prediction.
abstract_zh: 比特币为维护其去中心化网络所产生的全球碳排放量，其规模堪比整个国家，这使其面临旨在减少排放的气候政策的影响。本文构建了一个一般均衡框架，用以考察气候政策的严格程度如何影响比特币的估值及其与股票市场的关系。我们的理论分析得出一个关键见解：从宽松气候政策向严格气候政策的转变，会提高比特币与股票收益之间的条件相关性，从而削弱比特币作为对冲或分散股票市场波动工具的吸引力。实证证据支持了这一理论预测。

title: The price of delay: Supply chain disruptions and pricing dynamics
title_zh: 延迟的代价：供应链中断与定价动态
title_primary: 延迟的代价：供应链中断与定价动态
title_secondary: The price of delay: Supply chain disruptions and pricing dynamics
authors: Salomé Baslandze, Simon Fuchs
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how supply chain disruptions shape consumer prices. We develop a simple model showing how disruptions that cause delivery delays affect pricing through product availability, beyond standard cost pass-through, and extend it to include strategic interactions across firms. Empirically, we construct a novel micro-level dataset linking shipment-level U.S. import records from Bills of Lading to granular consumer prices from the Numerator panel. Using delivery shortfalls, port congestion, and import costs in a shift-share identification strategy, we estimate the pass-through of supply chain shocks to retail prices. We find sizable but incomplete pass-through: both imported-input cost shocks and delivery delays raise prices, with stronger responses when disruptions persist. Firms also raise prices when competitors face disruptions—including those that do not import directly—indicating strategic pricing spillovers. Combining these estimates with back-of-the-envelope calculations, we show such interactions substantially amplify aggregate price effects, particularly through product availability, during the pandemic.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了供应链中断如何影响消费者价格。我们构建了一个简洁模型，展示导致交货延迟的中断如何通过产品可得性影响定价，这超越了标准的成本传导机制，并将模型扩展至包含企业间的策略性互动。在实证方面，我们构建了一个新颖的微观层面数据集，将提单层面的美国进口记录与Numerator面板中的细粒度消费者价格相链接。利用交货短缺、港口拥堵及进口成本，并采用份额转移识别策略，我们估算了供应链冲击对零售价格的传导效应。研究发现传导效应显著但不完全：进口投入成本冲击与交货延迟均推高价格，且当中断持续时反应更为强烈。当竞争对手面临中断时——包括那些不直接进口的企业——企业也会提价，这表明存在策略性定价溢出效应。结合这些估计与粗略计算，我们表明此类互动显著放大了总体价格效应，尤其是在疫情期间，通过产品可得性渠道尤为突出。

title: Arrovian independence and the aggregation of choice functions
title_zh: 阿罗独立性公理与选择函数的加总
title_primary: 阿罗独立性公理与选择函数的加总
title_secondary: Arrovian independence and the aggregation of choice functions
authors: Claudio Kretz, Clemens Puppe
official: 官方在线 2026-04-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We reappraise the Arrow problem by studying the aggregation of choice functions. We do so in the general framework of judgment aggregation, in which choice functions are naturally representable by specifying, for each menu A and each alternative x in A , whether x is choosable from A , or not. Our framework suggests a natural strengthening of Arrow’s independence condition positing that the collective choosability of an alternative from a menu depends on the individual views on that issue, and that issue alone. Our analysis reveals that Arrovian impossibility results crucially hinge on what internal consistency requirements we impose on choice functions. While the aggregation of ‘binary’ choice functions, i.e.those satisfying both contraction (\(\alpha \)) and expansion (\(\gamma \)) consistency, is necessarily dictatorial, possibilities in the form of oligarchic rules emerge for path-independent choice functions, that is, when the expansion property \(\gamma \) is replaced by the so-called Aizerman condition. Remarkably, the Arrovian aggregation of choice functions is shown to be almost dictatorial already under property \(\gamma \) alone. When giving up expansion consistency, specific quota rules become possible.
abstract_zh: 我们通过研究选择函数的加总问题，重新审视了阿罗悖论。在判断加总的通用框架下，选择函数可自然地表示为：针对每个菜单A及其中的每个备选项x，明确x是否可从A中被选出。该框架提出了对阿罗独立性条件的自然强化，即集体对某备选项从某菜单中的可选择性，仅取决于个体对该议题的判断，且仅取决于该议题本身。分析表明，阿罗式不可能性结果的关键在于我们对选择函数施加何种内部一致性要求。当加总满足收缩一致性（\(\alpha\)）与扩张一致性（\(\gamma\)）的"二元"选择函数时，结果必然具有独裁性；而对于路径独立型选择函数（即用所谓的艾泽曼条件替代扩张性质\(\gamma\)），则可能出现寡头规则形式的可能性。值得注意的是，仅凭性质\(\gamma\)，阿罗式选择函数加总已近乎呈现独裁特征。若放弃扩张一致性，则特定配额规则成为可能。

title: Government litigation risk and the decline in low-income mortgage lending
title_zh: 政府诉讼风险与低收入群体抵押贷款发放的减少
title_primary: 政府诉讼风险与低收入群体抵押贷款发放的减少
title_secondary: Government litigation risk and the decline in low-income mortgage lending
authors: W. Scott Frame, Kristopher Gerardi, Erik J. Mayer, Billy Y. Xu, Lawrence Chengzhi Zhao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines the effect of Department of Justice lawsuits in the 2010s against large lenders for alleged fraud in the Federal Housing Administration (FHA) mortgage insurance program. The suits led to over $5 billion in settlements and caused targeted banks and their peers to precipitously exit the FHA market. Difference-in-differences and triple-differences tests exploiting geographic variation in exposure to exiting banks show an 18% reduction in FHA lending in heavily exposed areas. This reduction was not associated with improved underwriting standards or lower default rates. Large banks’ FHA exit has significantly reduced low-income households’ overall access to mortgage credit.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了2010年代美国司法部针对大型贷款机构在联邦住房管理局（FHA）抵押贷款保险项目中涉嫌欺诈提起的诉讼所产生的影响。这些诉讼导致了超过50亿美元的和解金，并促使目标银行及其同行迅速退出FHA市场。利用暴露于退出银行的地理差异进行的双重差分和三重差分检验显示，在高度暴露地区，FHA贷款减少了18%。这一减少并未与承保标准的改善或违约率的下降相关联。大型银行退出FHA市场显著降低了低收入家庭整体获得抵押贷款信贷的机会。

title: Endogenous dispersion and volatility in stock returns
title_zh: 股票收益的内生离散度与波动性
title_primary: 股票收益的内生离散度与波动性
title_secondary: Endogenous dispersion and volatility in stock returns
authors: Wukuang Cun, Junjie Xia
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Measures of stock market volatility, such as the cross-sectional dispersion of firm-level stock returns and the time-series volatility of market returns, fluctuate countercyclically. While this phenomenon is often used as evidence that exogenous rises in uncertainty lead to economic recessions, we show that first-moment productivity shocks can cause countercyclical fluctuations in stock market volatility. We study a dynamic model with costly state verification, allowing for ex-ante monitoring that can credibly compel borrowers to reveal true investment outcomes to lenders, thereby reducing information asymmetry. Interpreting these financial contracts as external equities, we show that the calibrated model, with only first-moment shocks, can generate cyclical fluctuations in equity return volatility and financial conditions, with correlation coefficients between pairs of these measures quantitatively in line with the data.
abstract_zh: 股票市场波动性的度量指标，如公司层面股票收益的横截面离散度和市场收益的时间序列波动性，呈现出逆周期波动。尽管这一现象常被用作外生不确定性上升导致经济衰退的证据，但我们表明，一阶矩生产率冲击能够引发股票市场波动性的逆周期波动。我们研究了一个带有昂贵状态验证的动态模型，允许事前监督，这种监督能够可信地迫使借款人向贷款人揭示真实投资结果，从而减少信息不对称。将这些金融合约解释为外部股权，我们表明，仅含一阶矩冲击的校准模型能够生成股权收益波动性和金融状况的周期性波动，且这些度量指标之间的相关系数在数量上与数据相符。

title: The Endogeneity of Liquidity Risk in Leveraged Fixed-Income Systems Book
title_zh: 杠杆固定收益系统中流动性风险的内生性
title_primary: 杠杆固定收益系统中流动性风险的内生性
title_secondary: The Endogeneity of Liquidity Risk in Leveraged Fixed-Income Systems Book
authors: Wagner, Leandro
official: 官方在线 2026-03-03 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Liquidity is central to modern fixed-income markets, yet it is often treated too simply. Bonds are commonly described as liquid or illiquid, as though liquidity were a fixed quality built into the security itself. This book challenges that view. It argues that liquidity is not a permanent feature of a bond, but a fragile condition created by market structure, financing arrangements, collateral rules, dealer capacity, valuation practices, regulation, and investor behaviour. The Endogeneity of Liquidity Risk in Leveraged Fixed-Income Systems develops a clear theory of how liquidity is created inside the financial system and how it can disappear under stress. A bond may appear easy to sell in calm markets, financeable through repo, acceptable as collateral, and stable in daily valuation. Yet those qualities may depend on conditions that change quickly when volatility rises, funding tightens, or many investors try to exit at the same time.
abstract_zh: 流动性是现代固定收益市场的核心，但往往被过于简单地对待。债券通常被描述为具有流动性或缺乏流动性，仿佛流动性是证券本身固有的固定属性。本书挑战了这一观点，认为流动性并非债券的永久特征，而是一种由市场结构、融资安排、抵押品规则、交易商能力、估值实践、监管和投资者行为共同创造的脆弱状态。《杠杆固定收益系统中流动性风险的内生性》构建了一套清晰的理论，阐释流动性如何在金融体系内部被创造出来，又如何在压力下消失。一只债券在平静市场中可能看似易于出售、可通过回购融资、可被接受为抵押品且日常估值稳定，但这些特质可能依赖于某些条件——当波动性上升、资金收紧或大量投资者同时试图退出时，这些条件会迅速改变。

title: Not gone with the wind: Long-run impact of herbicidal warfare in Vietnam
title_zh: 随风未逝：越南除草剂战争的长期影响
title_primary: 随风未逝：越南除草剂战争的长期影响
title_secondary: Not gone with the wind: Long-run impact of herbicidal warfare in Vietnam
authors: Gaku Ito, Duc Tran, Yuichiro Yoshida
official: 聚合元数据日期 2023-01-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We investigate the legacies of herbicidal warfare on population size and growth in Vietnam between 2001 and 2020. The identification strategy exploits flight-level military records and plausibly exogenous hamlet-level variation around the spray-on, direction-change, and spray-off points of fixed-wing aircraft missions, combined with a fuzzy regression kink design. The elasticity estimate suggests that a 10% increase in predicted herbicide exposure during the Vietnam War is persistently associated with a decrease in population size, ranging from 1.88–2.51% in 2001 to 2.61–3.27% in 2020. We also find that a 10% increase in predicted herbicide exposure is associated with a 0.75 percentage-point decrease in the population growth rate over the 2001–2020 period. These findings reveal previously unseen, lasting legacies of herbicidal warfare on contemporary population outcomes. The empirical patterns run counter to the conventional wisdom of a rapid recovery or a catch-up growth in post-war societies after destruction, while also contributing to the emerging debate over the socioeconomic and public health consequences of broader chemical exposure.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了2001年至2020年间越南除草剂战争对人口规模与增长的影响。识别策略利用飞行级别的军事记录，以及固定翼飞机任务喷洒开启、方向改变和喷洒关闭点周围看似外生的村庄级变异，结合模糊回归断点设计。弹性估计表明，越战期间预测除草剂暴露量增加10%，与人口规模持续下降相关联，从2001年的1.88%–2.51%降至2020年的2.61%–3.27%。我们还发现，预测除草剂暴露量增加10%，与2001–2020年间人口增长率下降0.75个百分点相关。这些发现揭示了除草剂战争对当代人口结果此前未被察觉的持久影响。实证模式与战后社会在破坏后迅速恢复或追赶性增长的传统观念相悖，同时也为关于更广泛化学暴露的社会经济及公共卫生后果的新兴辩论做出了贡献。
